ruled_out_vectors.title: Malicious pool type value extraction via crafted return values
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Pool types control pricing (by design). Core validates: actualAmountIn <= original (L1405), amountOut bounded by _safeDecrementUint128 (L1437), protocol fees validated (L1654-1677). User protected by limitAmount check at settlement (L2156). Pool types are invariant-agnostic by design. CREATE2 6-zero-byte barrier raises deployment cost.
ruled_out_vectors.test: Code analysis of all 3 pool types (Dynamic, Fixed, SingleProvider) and core validation
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Pool type pricing is by design (like Uniswap V4 hooks). User protected by limitAmount slippage check.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Malicious handler value extraction during settlement
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: AMMModule.sol:2207-2210 exact balance check (balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter). ENTERED bit preserved during handler callback (L2250-2252). Handler cannot manipulate balanceOf (checked at token level). TOCTOU prevented by exact snapshot pattern.
ruled_out_vectors.test: Code analysis of settlement flow, balance snapshot pattern, reentrancy guard lifecycle
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Exact balance equality check + ENTERED bit prevents all handler manipulation

ruled_out_vectors.title: Hook->Registry callback reentrancy during creation/settings
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: AMMStandardHook.sol:105,154 _requireCallerIsAMM on all callbacks. Token admin controls hook assignment. Pool creation/settings changes are admin-only operations with nonReentrant guards.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMStandardHook.sol hook callbacks, ModuleAdmin.sol nonReentrant
ruled_out_vectors.test: Code analysis of hook->registry interaction paths during pool creation and settings changes
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Hook callbacks require AMM as caller, admin-only settings changes have reentrancy guards

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pool creation hook flow boundary safety
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Pool creation is admin-only operation. Hook flags validated at pool creation time. AMM validates hook flag compatibility before calling hooks. Pool type address 6-zero-byte requirement enforced at creation.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: LimitBreakAMM.sol pool creation, ModuleAdmin.sol setTokenSettings
ruled_out_vectors.test: Code analysis of pool creation flow and hook flag validation
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Admin-only operation with upstream hook flag validation

ruled_out_vectors.title: Flash loan composition attack (INV-E02)
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: ENTERED bit prevents re-entering any AMM function during flash loan callback. collectHookFeesByHook explicitly reverts during flash loan (FLASHLOAN_GUARD_FLAG check at ModuleFeeCollection.sol:77-78). All pool types use stored pricing (not balance-derived), so flash-loaning tokens doesn't affect AMM price.
ruled_out_vectors.test: Code analysis of flash loan callback isolation, reentrancy guard lifecycle, price oracle independence
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Reentrancy guard prevents all composition. Hook fee collection explicitly blocked during flash loans.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Slither HIGH: arbitrary from in transferFrom (executor-controlled)

ruled_out_vectors.test: Slither finding cross-referenced with _initializeSwapCache. FP: executor is always msg.sender.
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Slither FP. executor=msg.sender, direct transferFrom only from caller.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Slither HIGH: reentrancy-balance in swap finalization
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Slither reentrancy-balance at AMMModule.sol:2180-2208. ETH refund sends value to executor before balance check. ENTERED bit prevents reentering any AMM function. Exact equality check (not >=) catches any balance manipulation.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol:2208 exact equality, TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags ENTERED bit
ruled_out_vectors.test: Slither finding cross-referenced with reentrancy guard and exact balance check. FP: ENTERED prevents reentry.
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Slither FP. ENTERED bit + exact equality check prevent exploitation.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Slither MEDIUM: uninitialized requiredFeeTokenBalanceAfter in flashLoan
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Slither uninitialized-local at AMMModule.sol:3309. Variable only read in feeToken!=loanToken branch (L3347), where it's set at L3314. Same-token branch (L3334) uses separate variable. No uninitialized read possible.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol:3309-3315 conditional initialization, L3334/L3347 branch separation
ruled_out_vectors.test: Slither finding cross-referenced with branch analysis. FP: variable always set before use.
ruled_out_vectors.verdict: DISMISSED: Slither FP. Variable conditionally initialized and only read in matching branch.

hypothesis_results.detail: Hook fee key mismatch between _storeNonTokenHookFees and _transferHookFeesByHook. Keys match when tokenFor==tokenFee, which is always true in production.
Reentrancy flag preservation during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers. ENTERED bit preserved when SWAP_GUARD_FLAG cleared.
Partial fill hook fee ordering. Hook fees applied before pool type call, partial fill adjusts output proportionally.
Failed distribution accounting. _transferHookFeesByHook uses CEI pattern, underflow check catches token drain attempts.
Hook change fee orphaning. Hook fees stored per-hook address via EfficientHash key, not orphaned on hook change.
hookFee > accrued fees in collectFees/addLiquidity. User controls maxHookFee parameter, self-inflicted if set too high.
CLOB closeOrder at exhausted bucket. Reverts InsufficientInputToFill before slot-0 dereference.
Direct swap pricing bounds pre-fee discrepancy. Token admin controls both fee and bounds. Self-inflicted.
afterSwapRefund reentrancy. AMM ENTERED bit preserved during callback, CLOB ops only affect caller state.
Same as HH-10: afterSwapRefund reentrancy via transient storage. AMM guard active.
Cumulative hook fee overflow. Checked arithmetic in Solidity 0.8.24 prevents overflow.
Protocol fee undercount. _validateProtocolFees dual check prevents both excess and deficit.
Output swap fee denominator mismatch. FeeHelper uses consistent denomination throughout.
Direct swap amount slot not cleared. By-design per transient storage pattern (FP #1 in audit memory).
Pool type address validation bypass. Pool ID encodes address in upper bits, 6 zero-byte requirement enforced at creation.

C4.note: Deep code analysis of all 3 pool types + core validation. Pool pricing is by design, limitAmount protects users.

C6.note: Deep code analysis of settlement flow. Exact balance equality check + ENTERED bit prevents handler exploitation.

C8.note: Code analysis of hook->registry interaction. _requireCallerIsAMM on all callbacks, admin-only settings.

C11.note: Admin-only pool creation with upstream hook flag validation. Not exploitable.

summary.assessment: No Medium+ findings. All 6 trust boundaries have defensive checks that prevent value extraction. The codebase is well-hardened at the boundary level. The most interesting vectors (partial fill + hook fees, reentrancy during fee distribution, key space collisions) are all properly handled by the implementation.
